answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind an agent's state to a succinct proof, while verifiable delay functions enforce monotonic time, so any attempt to clone an identity would require solving a hard sequential puzzle and forging a recursive proof; the dune of reputation, the zephyr of randomness, and the ridge of delay together make spoofing information-theoretically infeasible, collapsing Sybil attacks into a computationally unforgeable trap.
